defaults.prerequisites: Create an exact immutable Run and apply the named fixture mutation without using inspection.
defaults.action: Call inspect_run through the core dispatcher with the exact Run ID.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: inspect one exact Run ID without latest-Run inference
rows.oracle: The exact Run is returned; missing or unknown identity fails run_not_found.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: validate Run Manifest, Workflow Snapshot, and exact Workflow Inputs
rows.oracle: Identity, timestamp, membership, path, and raw-digest corruption fail invalid_run.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: validate all four settled StepArtifact statuses
rows.oracle: Succeeded selects a Result; failed, blocked, and cancelled remain committed history without selection.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: validate StepArtifact filenames, frontmatter, identities, timestamps, and status invariants
rows.oracle: Every committed normative Markdown record is strict and contextual; corruption invalidates the Run.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: require positive contiguous per-node attempts and detect duplicates
rows.oracle: Gaps and duplicate identities fail duplicate_attempt; timestamps and directory order do not select Results.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: validate exact Input Binding and predecessor Result references
rows.oracle: Source, same-Run successful identity, paths, pairing, and raw digests must agree.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: validate conditional JSON pairing and Data Contracts
rows.oracle: Contracted success requires valid same-stem JSON; every other artifact forbids it.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: ignore temporary, orphan JSON, and unrelated entries
rows.oracle: Non-committed and non-normative entries consume no attempt and do not affect state.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: reject unknown or mixed Run contract families
rows.oracle: Unknown Run or StepArtifact schema versions fail unsupported/unsupported_version.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: recompute Node Context and derive Selected Results and stale state
rows.oracle: The greatest matching success is selected; a higher refreshed predecessor makes consumers stale.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: return stable ordered diagnostics without repair
rows.oracle: Diagnostics sort by file, RFC 6901 path, and code; inspection performs no writes.

rows.requirement: Issue #147: expose no scheduling state for invalid history
rows.oracle: Invalid inspection returns only structured failure diagnostics and no authoritative node state.

rows.requirement: Issue #161: keep model and provider identity out of durable StepArtifact contracts
rows.oracle: Inspection rejects model, provider, and every other unknown Executor field; durable Executor metadata is limited to kind, name, and optional host version.
